root.label: Japanese investors shift into foreign equities in August 2026

events.label: Japanese investors shift into foreign equities in August 2026

slots.name: foreign equity purchases
slots.sentence: Japanese investors made their biggest shift toward overseas equities in five months in August, pouring 1.3 trillion yen ($8.45 billion) into foreign shares while cutting holdings of overseas bonds

slots.name: short-term debt sales
slots.sentence: Japanese investors sold a net 1.02 trillion yen of foreign short-term debt

slots.name: long-term bond sales
slots.sentence: and 143 billion yen of long-term bonds

slots.name: trust equity purchases
slots.sentence: Japanese investment trust management companies were the biggest buyers of overseas equities, purchasing a net 1.35 trillion yen in August.

slots.name: insurer equity purchases
slots.sentence: Life insurers bought 24.9 billion yen of foreign shares.

slots.name: trust bond sales
slots.sentence: investment trusts selling 30.1 billion yen of long-term bonds

slots.name: pension equity purchases
slots.sentence: while also purchasing 567.1 billion yen of overseas equities.

slots.name: prior equity purchase peak
slots.sentence: The net purchases of foreign equities were the largest since 2.22 trillion yen in March, Ministry of Finance data showed on Tuesday.

slots.name: pension bond purchases
slots.sentence: Pension funds moved in the opposite direction in fixed income, buying 2.33 trillion yen of foreign bonds while also purchasing 567.1 billion yen of overseas equities.
